source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In a phase 2 selumetinib trial stratum of 25 children with recurrent, refractory or progressive NF1-associated low-grade glioma, 10 (40%) achieved a sustained partial response (>=50% reduction in tumor cross-product) and 15 (60%) had stable disease.
